mapper.select: SELECT dr.*, d.DOMAIN_NM FROM TB_DOMAIN_RULE dr LEFT JOIN TB_DOMAIN d ON d.DOMAIN_ID = dr.DOMAIN_ID WHERE dr.DOMAIN_ID = #{domainId} AND dr.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY dr.SORT_ORD
SELECT dr.*, d.DOMAIN_NM FROM TB_DOMAIN_RULE dr LEFT JOIN TB_DOMAIN d ON d.DOMAIN_ID = dr.DOMAIN_ID WHERE dr.DOMAIN_RULE_ID = #{domainRuleId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_DOMAIN_RULE ( DOMAIN_RULE_ID, DOMAIN_ID, RULE_NM, RULE_TYPE, RULE_PARAMS, SORT_ORD, USE_YN, DESCR, CRET_USER_ID, CRET_DT ) VALUES ( #{domainRuleId}, #{domainId}, #{ruleNm}, #{ruleType}, #{ruleParams}, COALESCE(#{sortOrd}, 1), COALESCE(#{useYn}, 'Y'), #{descr}, #{cretUserId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_DOMAIN_RULE SET RULE_NM = #{ruleNm}, RULE_TYPE = #{ruleType}, RULE_PARAMS = #{ruleParams}, SORT_ORD = #{sortOrd}, USE_YN = #{useYn}, DESCR = #{descr}, UPDT_USER_ID = #{updtUserId}, UPDT_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE DOMAIN_RULE_ID = #{domainRuleId}
mapper.select: SELECT dr.*, d.DOMAIN_NM FROM TB_DOMAIN_RULE dr LEFT JOIN TB_DOMAIN d ON d.DOMAIN_ID = dr.DOMAIN_ID WHERE dr.DOMAIN_ID = #{domainId} AND dr.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY dr.SORT_ORD LIMIT 1

SELECT d.DOMAIN_ID AS "domainId", d.DOMAIN_NM AS "domainNm", d.DOMAIN_CLSF_NM AS "domainClsfNm", d.DATA_TYPE AS "dataType", d.DATA_LEN AS "dataLen", COALESCE(dr.RULE_CNT, 0) AS "ruleCnt" FROM TB_DOMAIN d LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DOMAIN_ID, COUNT(*) AS RULE_CNT FROM TB_DOMAIN_RULE WHERE USE_YN = 'Y' GROUP BY DOMAIN_ID ) dr ON dr.DOMAIN_ID = d.DOMAIN_ID WHERE d.APRV_YN = 'Y'
AND (d.DOMAIN_NM ILIKE '%' || #{schNm} || '%' OR d.DOMAIN_CLSF_NM ILIKE '%' || #{schNm} || '%')
ORDER BY COALESCE(d.DOMAIN_CLSF_NM, 'ZZZ_미분류'), d.DOMAIN_NM
